body:
Please make sure all items start with Verify that... and that the item is SMART:
Specific - talks about one thing only if possible
Measurable - easily discoverable if possible 
Achievable - can this be discovered and fixed by average developers, pen testers, etc?
Relevant - does this control actually make sense to hassle devs and testers?
Time bound - takes no more than 15 minutes to find in a typical app?

Remember the ASVS is the 80/20 of app sec standards. We are not trying to be the 100% standard (well, if you have to, it belongs in Level 3).
title: Verify that...
